compendiumTab.title: Compendium Tab
compendiumTab.content: Content packs are imported from the Compendium Tab

compendiumManagerButton.title: LANCER Compendium Manager
compendiumManagerButton.content:
Click here to manage core data and imported LCPs.

Core NPC data is paid content and is not included with this system, but can be added from here.

lcpTable.title: LCP Table
lcpTable.content:
You can select and bulk-import official content here. Any LCPs you manually install will also be shown at the end of the table.

Core NPC data is paid content and is not included with the system.

lcpUpdate.title: Bulk Import / Update
lcpUpdate.content: Click here to install or update all selected LCPs from their official sources.

lcpFile.title: File Selector
lcpFile.content:
Click here to install an LCP from its `.lcp` file here.

This is where you can import the Core NPC data files.

lcpImport.title: Import
lcpImport.content: Once you've selected a file, click here to import its contents into the compendiums

clearData.title: Clear Data
clearData.content:
Click here to delete imported content and core data.

This CANNOT be undone and the only way to restore is to rebuild the core data and re-import the lcp files.
